additional_info.subject: Incident Report – SiCharge D (S/N Y2/R4 31298223001) – CCS2 Error
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I’m reporting an issue detected on the SiCharge D unit, serial number Y2/R4 31298223001.
The CCS2 connector is currently in error mode with the following message:
Vendor specific error

Could you please schedule an intervention to correct the fault and share the root cause along with the corrective actions planned?
Thank you in advance for your prompt response.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob: +33 650 370 485
